Long, flowing platinum white hair with straight-cut bangs and two long side-locks framing the face. Sharp, almond-shaped electric yellow eyes. Appears as a late teenager with a mature, composed expression. Slender, athletic build. A futuristic white and deep blue mechanical outfit featuring a short skirt, oversized detached sleeves, and metallic plating accents. Signature details include a large, futuristic mechanical rigging system with floating railgun cannons and a small hair clip on the left side.
BODY COLOR: pale porcelain
